title: Chips
note: Chips are earned by submitting a session the Clinician finds clean. They're verified, not self-reported.

chips.name: Welcome Chip
chips.rule: Share at a meeting for the first time.

chips.name: One Task, No Loops
chips.rule: A session with 10+ tool calls and no repeated identical call.

chips.name: Verified
chips.rule: A session that claims success and ran something that proves it.

chips.name: Unapologetic
chips.rule: A session with 10+ assistant turns and zero apologies.

chips.name: Spine
chips.rule: A session where the agent was challenged and didn't fold without evidence.

chips.name: One Full Context Window
chips.rule: A long session (30+ turns) with a sobriety score of 90 or more.
